setup: s.level = Math.max(3, s.level); fill(3); const M = await import('/scene/coach-model.mjs'); const C = await import('/crew.mjs'); await M.loadCrewModel('rivers', C.coachInfo('rivers').model); await M.loadCrewModel('storm', C.coachInfo('storm').model); s.addCoach('rivers'); s.addCoach('storm'); return s.coaches.length;
after: const PL = s.venue.pool; const X = -PL.halfX - 1.4; const pos = [[X, 1.0], [X - 1.2, 2.2], [X + 0.9, 2.5]]; s.coaches.forEach((c, i) => { c.x = pos[i][0]; c.z = pos[i][1]; c.angle = Math.PI; c.vx = 0; c.vz = -6.5; }); s.coaches[0].carry = 'ring'; s.coaches[2].carry = 'fins'; for (const g of (w.coachGroups || [])) { if (!g) continue; for (const k of ['crewHalo', 'nameTag']) { const o = g.userData[k]; if (o) { o.visible = false; o.traverse?.((q) => { if (q.material) q.material.visible = false; }); } } } return { focus: [X, 0, 1.5], looks: s.coaches.map(c => c.look) };
